description: This file defines the PdfDocumentRenderer class, which provides functionality to convert a MigraDoc document into a PDF document using PdfSharp. It includes methods for setting documents, preparing pages for rendering, rendering pages or entire documents, and saving the resulting PDF file. It also manages PDF document properties such as metadata and embedded files.

classes.name: PdfDocumentRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering MigraDoc documents as PDFs, including page preparation, rendering, and saving functionalities.

methods.name: PdfDocumentRenderer
methods.description: Default constructor for initializing a new instance of PdfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: PdfDocumentRenderer(bool unicode)
methods.description: Obsolete constructor indicating that Unicode is always used for text rendering.

methods.name: PrepareDocumentRenderer
methods.description: Prepares the document renderer, optionally creating all fonts and formatting the document.

methods.name: RenderDocument
methods.description: Renders the entire document into the PDF.

methods.name: PrepareRenderPages
methods.description: Prepares pages for rendering, including embedding files and writing document info.

methods.name: RenderPages
methods.description: Renders a range of pages from the document into the PDF.

methods.name: Save (string path)
methods.description: Saves the PDF to the specified file path, overwriting if it exists.

methods.name: Save (Stream stream, bool closeStream)
methods.description: Saves the PDF into a provided stream.

methods.name: WriteDocumentInformation
methods.description: Writes metadata such as author, subject, title, and keywords into the PDF.

methods.name: CreatePdfDocument
methods.description: Creates a new PdfDocument instance with appropriate metadata.
